therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: optimized neurohormonal blockade and decongestion in heart failure
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with heart failure and left ventricular dysfunction
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Composite non-parametric rank score of cardiovascular death, cardiovascular hospitalization days, and KCCQ symptom score at 9 months

results.effect_size: Mean rank score: NT-proBNP-guided 118.6 vs. not guided 128.4 (lower score is worse; no statistically significant difference reported)
results.target_engagement_evidence: NT-proBNP geometric mean at 9 months: guided arm 2332.1 ng/L vs. not-guided 2063 ng/L
biomarker_changes: NT-proBNP geometric mean at 9 months: guided arm 2332.1 ng/L (95% CI 1986.1–2738.4), not-guided arm 2063 ng/L (95% CI 1743.2–2442.7)
safety_signals: 8 discontinuations due to adverse events in guided arm vs. 6 in not-guided arm
Serious adverse events were similar between arms; notable SAEs included anaemia, angina pectoris, atrial fibrillation

context.indication: Heart failure with left ventricular dysfunction
context.comparator: Heart failure treatment guided by clinical symptoms and signs alone (not guided by NT-proBNP)

results_by_chain.population_description: Heart failure patients with left ventricular dysfunction managed with NT-proBNP-guided therapy titration
